movies.overview: In Casablanca, Morocco in December 1941, a cynical American expatriate meets a former lover, with unforeseen complications.
movies.title: Casablanca
movies.tagline: They had a date with fate in Casablanca!

movies.original_title: To Be or Not to Be
movies.overview: During the Nazi occupation of Poland, an acting troupe becomes embroiled in a Polish soldier's efforts to track down a German spy.
movies.title: To Be or Not to Be
movies.tagline: The Picture Everyone Wants to See

movies.overview: Bambi's tale unfolds from season to season as the young prince of the forest learns about life, love, and friends.
movies.title: Bambi
movies.tagline: Love Comes To The Forest Folk . . . and to you, in one of the world's greatest love stories!

movies.overview: Paris, France. Commissaire Wens follows the lead of a ruthless murderer to an unexpected place.
movies.title: The Murderer Lives at Number 21

movies.overview: A Serbian émigré in Manhattan believes that, because of an ancient curse, any physical intimacy with the man she loves will turn her into a feline predator.
movies.title: Cat People
movies.tagline: She knew strange, fierce pleasures that no other woman could ever feel!

movies.overview: As bare-knuckled boxing enters the modern era, brash extrovert Jim Corbett uses new rules and dazzlingly innovative footwork to rise to the top of the boxing world.
movies.title: Gentleman Jim
movies.tagline: The grandest story of the Naughty "Nineties" becomes the gayest picture of the Fighting "Forties!"

movies.overview: The spoiled young heir to the decaying Amberson fortune comes between his widowed mother and the man she has always loved.
movies.title: The Magnificent Ambersons
movies.tagline: Real life screened more daringly than it’s ever been before!

movies.overview: Aircraft factory worker Barry Kane flees across the United States after he is wrongly accused of starting the fire that killed his best friend.
movies.title: Saboteur
movies.tagline: Unmasking the man behind your back!

movies.overview: At the end of the 15th century, a man and a woman, posing as traveling minstrels, are sent by the Devil to a castle to seduce its inhabitants.
movies.title: The Devil's Envoys

movies.overview: Yet another variation on the Three Little Pigs theme, this time told as WW2 anti-German propaganda (the US had just entered the war), with the wolf as a thinly-disguised Hitler.
movies.title: Blitz Wolf

movies.overview: Successful movie director John L. Sullivan, convinced he won't be able to film his ambitious masterpiece until he has suffered, dons a hobo disguise and sets off on a journey, aiming to "know trouble" first-hand. When all he finds is a train ride back to Hollywood and a beautiful blonde companion, he redoubles his efforts, managing to land himself in more trouble than he bargained for when he loses his memory and ends up a prisoner on a chain gang.
movies.title: Sullivan's Travels
movies.tagline: Veronica Lake’s on the Take

movies.overview: Loursat, a lawyer, lives with his daughter Nicole in a sinister and vast bourgeois residence. Abandoned for nearly twenty years by his wife, the brilliant lawyer has sunk into alcoholism and his relationship with his daughter is virtually non-existent. However, one day the corpse of a stranger is discovered in the residence of Loursat. Nicole, who frequents a gang of young people who escape boredom by stealing cars and other objects, is immediately suspected.
movies.title: Strangers in the House

movies.overview: Low on funds, working-class girl Susan Applegate disguises herself as a youngster in order to pay half fare home. But little 'Sue Sue' finds herself in a whole heap of grownup trouble when she hides out in a compartment with handsome Major Philip Kirby.
movies.title: The Major and the Minor
movies.tagline: Is she a kid - or is she kidding?

movies.overview: A whimsical blend of live action and animation, "Saludos Amigos" is a colorful kaleidoscope of art, adventure and music set to a toe-tapping samba beat. From high Andes peaks and Argentina's pampas to the sights and sounds of Rio de Janeiro, your international traveling companions are none other than those famous funny friends, Donald Duck and Goofy. They keep things lively as Donald encounters a stubborn llama and "El Gaucho" Goofy tries on the cowboy way of life....South American-style.
movies.title: Saludos Amigos
movies.tagline: Walt Disney goes South American in his gayest musical Technicolor feature

movies.overview: Shuhei Horikawa, a poor schoolteacher, struggles to raise his son Ryohei by himself, despite neither money nor prospects.
movies.title: There Was a Father

movies.overview: Sadistic killer-for-hire Philip Raven becomes enraged when his latest job is paid off in marked bills. Vowing to track down his double-crossing boss, nightclub executive Gates, Raven sits beside Gates' lovely new employee, Ellen, on a train out of town. Although Ellen is engaged to marry the police lieutenant who's hunting down Raven, she decides to try and set the misguided hit man straight as he hides from the cops and plots his revenge.
movies.title: This Gun for Hire
movies.tagline: A Lone Wolf…dynamite with a girl or a gun!

movies.overview: Middle-class housewife Kay Miniver deals with petty problems. She and her husband Clem watch her Oxford-educated son Vin court Carol Beldon, the charming granddaughter of the local nobility as represented by Lady Beldon. Then the war comes and Vin joins the RAF.
movies.title: Mrs. Miniver
movies.tagline: "Mrs. Miniver" is more than a picture... It's dramatic. It's tender. It's human. It's real.

movies.overview: A New York inventor, Tom Jeffers, needs cash to develop his big idea, so his adoring wife, Gerry, decides to raise it by divorcing him and marrying an eccentric Florida millionaire, J. D. Hackensacker III.
movies.title: The Palm Beach Story
movies.tagline: Love is fickle! Love is is blind! She runs 'round the country...with him behind!

movies.overview: A 17th-century witch returns to wreak havoc in the life of a descendant of the Puritan witch hunter who burned her, but runs afoul of her father when she discovers that her mischief might have found her true love.
movies.title: I Married a Witch
movies.tagline: No man can resist her!

movies.overview: Mowgli, lost in the jungle when a toddler, raised by wolves, years later happens upon his human village and reconnects with its inhabitants, including his widowed mother. Continuing to maintain a relationship with the jungle, adventures follow.
movies.title: Jungle Book
movies.tagline: A jewelled secret city...guarded by the jungle's fiercest denizens!

movies.overview: The Florida Keys in 1840, where the implacable hurricanes of the Caribbean scream, where the salvagers of Key West, like the intrepid and beautiful Loxi Claiborne and her crew, reap, aboard frail schooners, the harvest of the wild wind, facing the shark teeth of the reefs to rescue the sailors and the cargo from the shipwrecks caused by the scavengers of the sea.
movies.title: Reap the Wild Wind
movies.tagline: Cecil B. DeMille's GREATEST TRIUMPH! OUT-THRILLS ALL OTHER SCREEN SPECTACLES!

movies.overview: When notorious pirate Henry Morgan is made governor of Jamaica, he enlists the help of some of his former partners in ridding the Caribbean of buccaneers. When one of them apparently abducts the previous governor's pretty daughter and joins up with the rebels, things are set for a fight.
movies.title: The Black Swan
movies.tagline: Seas ablaze...with black villainy, with fiery romance, with breathless deeds of daring...in the roaring era of love, gold, and adventure!

movies.overview: Two schoolboys, Carlitos and Eduardo, fight for the affection of a girl, Teresinha.
movies.title: Aniki-Bóbó

movies.overview: The quiet village of Bramley End is taken over by German troops posing as Royal Engineers. Their task is to disrupt England's radar network in preparation for a full scale German invasion. Once the villagers discover the true identity of the troops, they do whatever they can to thwart the Nazis plans.
movies.title: Went the Day Well?
movies.tagline: Went the day well? We died and never knew. But, well or ill, freedom we died for you.

movies.overview: Rival reporters Sam Craig and Tess Harding fall in love and get married, only to find their relationship strained when Sam comes to resent Tess' hectic lifestyle.
movies.title: Woman of the Year
movies.tagline: The picture of the year!

movies.overview: Circus owner Buck Rand kidnaps Boy to perform in his show. He forces a pilot to fly him, Boy and his animal trainer out of the jungle. Tarzan and Jane follow them to New York.
movies.title: Tarzan's New York Adventure
movies.tagline: You never saw anything like it!

movies.overview: A crooked politician finds himself being accused of murder by a gangster from whom he refused help during a re-election campaign.
movies.title: The Glass Key
movies.tagline: The Tougher They Are—The Harder They Fall

movies.overview: During WWII, when an allied bomber is shot down over Germany, the five surviving crew are captured but cleverly escape detention after learning German secret information and knocking out a Nazi major.  With the angry major in hot pursuit, aided by military personnel, Gestapo agents and Hitler-loyal citizens, the five wend their way across perilous Germany, intent on reaching the UK with the secrets they have learned.
movies.title: Desperate Journey
movies.tagline: Man alive, Just picture this excitement!

movies.overview: Wandered away from his asylum, an amnesiac World War I veteran falls in love with a music hall star but his amnesia makes it difficult to last.
movies.title: Random Harvest
movies.tagline: He had found love - lost it - and now had found it again!

movies.overview: Denis, a poor student in philosophy, works as a night porter in the Paris market of Les Halles in order to pay for his studies. Constantly weary, he falls asleep and dreams of a beautiful girl in white, Irène, with whom he falls in love.
movies.title: Fantastic Night

movies.overview: The early worm barely escapes the bird, again. In search of a way to get rid of the bird, he enlists the help of a cat, but the bird is too smart for the cat.
movies.title: The Early Bird Dood It!

movies.overview: Hilarity ensues when a falsely accused fugitive from justice hides at the house of his childhood friend, which she has recently rented to a high-principled law teacher.
movies.title: The Talk of the Town
movies.tagline: Three people who make life more exciting... love more precious... laughter more joyous!

movies.overview: A radio correspondent tries to rescue a burlesque queen from her marriage to a Nazi official.
movies.title: Once Upon a Honeymoon
movies.tagline: Gee it's great to be together at last on another fellows honeymoon!

movies.overview: A woman suffers a nervous breakdown and an oppressive mother before being freed by the love of a man she meets on a cruise.
movies.title: Now, Voyager
movies.tagline: It happens in the best of families. But you'd never think it could happen to her!

movies.overview: A film of the life of the renowned musical composer, playwright, actor, dancer and singer George M. Cohan.
movies.title: Yankee Doodle Dandy
movies.tagline: Get ready to Laugh, to Sing, to Shout! ...For here comes Uncle Sam's Star Spangled Yankee Doodle Dandy!

movies.overview: Susan Miller works behind the girdle counter in a department store and dreams about the beautiful clothes and glamour she can never hope to have. Enter May Worthington and Warren, a pair of con artists who pose as the mother and uncle of a pretty girl in order to separate millionaires from their money. They convince Susan she has an opportunity to fulfill all her dreams, and the trio heads for Palm Beach. Susan meets John Wheeler who says he is shopping for a sailboat. Believing that he is a millionaire, Warren and May sell him a boat that doesn't belong to them, and make off with his $15,000 life savings. Looking for greener pastures, they work themselves into the family of wealthy Tod Fenwick, who falls for Sue, posing as "Linda Worthington". But John shows up as a guest of Fenwick and he tells "Linda", not knowing she was part of the scam, that he has a detective after the fake captain that sold him the boat...
movies.title: Rings on Her Fingers
movies.tagline: she kissed him out of his life's savings... but the poor guy loved it

movies.overview: Goofy's plans to give a swimming lesson and enjoy a day at the beach go awry.
movies.title: How to Swim
movies.tagline: Goofy demonstrates how to swim.

movies.overview: Frankenstein's unscrupulous colleague, Dr. Bohmer, plans to transplant Ygor's brain so he can rule the world using the monster's body, but the plan goes sour when he turns malevolent and goes on a rampage.
movies.title: The Ghost of Frankenstein
movies.tagline: NEW THRILLS as the Monster stalks again!

movies.original_title: Son of Fury: The Story of Benjamin Blake
movies.overview: Sir Arthur Blake has inherited title and lands from his brother. He also has his orphaned nephew Benjamin working for him as a bonded servant. While he believes the lad was born out of wedlock and so cannot claim the inheritance, he is taking no chances. Benjamin eventually rebels against his uncle and sets sail to try and make his fortune. This may enable him to return to prove his claim to being the rightful heir to the estate.
movies.title: Son of Fury: The Story of Benjamin Blake
movies.tagline: Bold Swooping Tremendous Adventure!

movies.overview: Ten screenwriters collaborated on this series of tales concerning the effect a tailcoat cursed by its tailor has on those who wear it. The video release features a W.C. Fields segment not included in the original theatrical release.
movies.title: Tales of Manhattan
movies.tagline: An Experience You'll never forget !

movies.overview: An Argentine heiress thinks a penniless American dancer is her secret admirer.
movies.title: You Were Never Lovelier
movies.tagline: Hayworth's glowing beauty! Astaire's glorious rhythm! Kern's greatest score since "Show Boat"!

movies.overview: Goofy's demonstration of fishing is fouled up by his clumsy casting and fly fishing, and problems with his boat.
movies.title: How to Fish
movies.tagline: Goofy shows us how to fish… or how not to!

movies.overview: A marching band of Germans, Italians, and Japanese march through the streets of swastika-motif Nutziland, serenading "Der Fuehrer's Face." Donald Duck, not living in the region by choice, struggles to make do with disgusting Nazi food rations and then with his day of toil at a Nazi artillery factory. After a nervous breakdown, Donald awakens to find that his experience was in fact a nightmare.
movies.title: Der Fuehrer's Face
movies.tagline: The picture from which the song sensation was taken!

movies.overview: Caprices tells the story of two young rich people. A famous actress poses as a poor florist, and a distinguished society man camouflages himself as forger and swindler. This game leads them to make close relations in a series of adventures.
movies.title: Whims

movies.overview: When honest ship captain Roy Glennister gets swindled out of his mine claim, he turns to saloon singer Cherry Malotte for assistance in his battle with no-good town kingpin Alexander McNamara.
movies.title: The Spoilers
movies.tagline: Crashing Fists in the Gold-Crazed Alaska of '98!

movies.overview: The Invisible Man's grandson uses his secret formula to spy on Nazi Germany.
movies.title: Invisible Agent
movies.tagline: Today's most amazing sensation!

movies.original_title: Sherlock Holmes and the Voice of Terror
movies.overview: England, at the start of World War Two. Mysterious wireless broadcasts, apparently from Nazi Germany are heard over the BBC. They warn of acts of terror in England, just before they take place. Baffled, the Defense Committee call in Sherlock Holmes.
movies.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Voice of Terror
movies.tagline: THE MASTER MINDS OF MYSTERY!

movies.overview: After a drunken night out, a longshoreman thinks he may have killed a man.
movies.title: Moontide
movies.tagline: A Great New Star to thrill you! Strange romance to intrigue you!

movies.overview: Travelling family man Paolo agrees to pose as husband to an unwed pregnant girl he meets on a train. However, once faced with her father, things do not go as planned.
movies.title: Four Steps in the Clouds
